reason: Solstheim's open-sea cells that have a CELL record and no LAND: named explicitly, as config/chim-cells.json names the main game's open-sea cells with a record (the regions preflight takes open sea only from an explicit cell list). The build module bloodmoon-solstheim takes them with the named set solstheim (tools/bloodmoon_solstheim_module.py module_plan); each is an ocean frame of the module's world with its row in the module's rows file, its levelled creature placements deferred as in every ocean cell (tools/chim/ocean_runtime.py admit_cell). A cell listed here needs the status ocean in the tracker reference, or the module's preflight refuses the build (CHIM-SEA-BETWEEN-ISLANDS-64).
notes: -20,15: two levelled horker lists (bm_ex_horker_h20), no LAND, status ocean. -29,23 and -28,24: a CELL record each in Bloodmoon.esm only, no name, no region, no LAND, nothing placed (the kind of the main game's open-sea cells with a record); status ocean on Solstheim from the CHIM import of the open sea of 22 November 2026, which names each cell's island by the master that holds its record (TRACKER-OCEAN-CELL-ISLAND-BASE-ONLY-68). -19,14 and -19,15, of the same kind as -20,15, are the base world's ocean frames (config/chim-cells.json) and are not listed here. With these three every open-sea cell of Solstheim in the tracker reference is listed.
